# ELK.js 0.12.0

Unmodified layout engine bundle from https://registry.npmjs.org/elkjs/-/elkjs-0.12.0.tgz.
Source: https://github.com/kieler/elkjs/tree/v0.12.0.
Distributed under EPL-2.0; see ELK-LICENSE.md. No source modifications.

The bundle runs locally inside the exported page, with no CDN or external layout service.
Update by replacing the bundle and license from the npm package, then run the viewer tests.
